summary: Our project explores NASA's historic hardware left behind on the Moon and Mars, focusing on iconic artifacts like Apollo Lunar Module descent stages, Lunar Roving Vehicles (LRVs), ALSEP scientific packages, and Surveyor landers. By turning dense historical and scientific data into an engaging video narrative, we bridge the gap between complex space archives and young space enthusiasts, showcasing the silent monuments that paved the way for modern space exploration.
details: Our video-driven project, titled "Abandoned but not Forgotten," is an  engaging educational narrative created for school-age space enthusiasts. Based on our video, the project brings NASA's silent historic hardware—specifically the Apollo Lunar Roving Vehicle (LRV)—back to life. It highlights why the rover was built to help astronauts travel  beyond walking distance, how its features worked (such as the T-handle  joystick, wire-mesh wheels, and high-gain antenna), and how it enabled  humanity to explore lunar terrain, collect samples, and broadcast history  back to Earth.
